biotools.summary: Optimizing methods for liquid chromatography coupled to mass spectrometry (LC-MS) poses a nontrivial challenge. The rawDiag package facilitates rational method optimization by generating MS operator-tailored diagnostic plots of scan-level metadata. The package is designed for use on the R shell or as a Shiny application on the Orbitrap instrument PC.
